parts.prompt:
A function g is continuous on [1,4], with g(1)=−2 and g(4)=5. Which conclusion is guaranteed?

A. g has exactly one zero in (1,4)
B. g has at least one zero in (1,4)
C. g is increasing on [1,4]
D. g′ exists everywhere on (1,4)
